description: Publish HTML pages, images, PDFs, ZIP (unzip hosting) and Markdown documents to htmlhoster.com and get back a public URL. Use this whenever an agent needs to host generated web pages, static assets, or rendered markdown and return a shareable link. Works for WorkBuddy, Claude Code, Codex, and any CLI agent.
